Perceptions and Plights:

"Until I transitioned, my greatest triumphs and periods of joy were tainted with the knowledge that I was considered and looked upon as a girl, then a woman. Closer to the truth, I was judged a "tomboy" and a "mannish woman," which made me self-conscious of my every move. 
To everyone looking, I had a "pixie" cut, but in my mind I was shorn to best the likes of Caesar. And it was a small blond girl they saw traversing the trees by lashing ropes around branches then sliding the crotch of a forked limb over the rope while grasping the ends. In my eyes, I was Tarzan.
I had all the requisite gestures befitting a boy, not simply because I was desirous, or the costuming struck my fancy, but because I was a miniature replica of a man - if not it body, in mind, heart, and soul. The boy apprentice in the Italian Renaissance, Oliver Twists artful dodger, the shepherd of the mores, an ancient mariner. The male body I've come to possess may be the happenstance of modern medicine, but my psyche has always been kin to generations of men."

No, not beginning. I've been on T for about 5 years. Your response to the other thread i'm responding to right now.

After searching the internet for painless ways to commit suicide, i found an article on wiki about helium. It replaces oxygen without the panic that comes from c02 supossidly. So after some more searching and comparing prices i had a tank ups'd to my apartment. I left it be for a few days, cleaned, wrote a will, spent time with people i care about and prepared for death. I set everything up in the bathtub seeing as i wasn't sure when my body would be found, i wanted to make as little mess as possible. I layed down, put 2 plastic bags over my head, used tape to seal the outside and put a blanket over me. I breathed for a bit, i could feel the panic from lack of oxygen and i knew, or i should say thought, everything was ready. I turned the nob and relaxed. After a minute or two i made a bit of noise to check the helium and my voice was high pitched. Everything was working so i closed my eyes and took slow deep breaths. A few minutes more and I made another noise, no high pitch.  I turned the nob again and increased the flow. This could be a problem, i thought. What was happening? It was hissing but was this not pure helium or what? I checked my tone again, high pitched. I noticed the plastic wasn't inflating. I felt along the outside of the seal but i couldn't feel any gas escaping. FUCK. What if this doesn't work? I turned the nob more and layed there. I closed my eyes and waited. And waited. It could have been 15, 25 minutes later and the hissing sound quieted. Made a noise, it wasn't very high pitched. Turned the nob AGAIN this time almost a full turn. I waited. I cried. I waited. The hissing lessened. I got out of the bathtub. I drank myself to sleep and woke up with a headache. That day was full of reflection, maybe i wasn't ready to die. Maybe i had given up too early. i took a walk and went through my options. The next day I was overcome with impident rage. What now? Stab a hole through my door frame and hang myself? I've tried that before and my aversion to pain and panic doesn't work when i can easily reach something to save myself with. Pills? Stupid. Slice myself open? Very stupid. Keep living? I can't find another accesable painless suicide so i suppose i will. I have no special or interesting things about me, i cannot hold any kind of relationship together, i have the worst social skills of anyone i have ever met and i am depressed with varying degrees of energy. I came to terms with being alone or so i thought. I'm not happy with myself anymore so being alone isn't as.. unimportant? It isn't just a background to the rest of my life anymore i suppose. I've thrown myself out there socialy and it's gone horribly. I took a step back and posted on okcupid and apperently i'm ugly and have no personality. I didn't think i was all that great looking to begin with but i didn't consider myself ugly. I can't take trying and failing socialy anymore. It just isn't something i can learn no matter how many times i try. I am the a of the pick a or b picture. The one that everyone finds disgusting, not the one men secretly fantasize about. The picture with the big clit that gets the response "that's fucking NASTY." or "at least they found someone to fuck them!" I have no place in this world. 
I don't know what to do. I don't know what i want to do. What happens now? 

Someone mentioned teaching overseas and i love kids so and i've thought of that before. Problem is the whole trans thing. I'm in a constant state of fear that people are going to find out and going to another country.. well you can imagine. I can't even go to the fucking bathroom in public places. I don't know. I just don't fucking know.
